title: Balaam was a prophet…
paragraphs:
Balaam was a prophet…
but he couldn’t see what his donkey saw.
Sometimes pride blinds us to the very thing God is trying to stop.
Have you ever realized later that a “delay” was actually protection?
The prophet didn’t see the angel.

God will use anything
to stop you from walking into danger.
Even the thing you’re frustrated with.

Balaam thought the donkey was the problem.
The donkey was the warning.

Not every delay is a setback.
Some are mercy.
“Sometimes the thing blocking your path is actually protecting you. Has that ever happened in your life?”
